# `CommandSequence`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\StateMachine\CommandSequence`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/StateMachine/CommandSequence.php#L18) — **Version:** working tree

**Implements:** `Stringable`

A generated, valid-by-construction sequence of Commands together with
the initial model it was generated against.

This is the value a [`Gen`](/api/classes/Gen)::commands() arbitrary
produces; the property body hands it to [`StateMachine\StateMachine`](/api/classes/StateMachine/StateMachine)::check(). It is
\Stringable so a falsified property renders the failing sequence as a
readable trace instead of `[N element(s)]`.
